description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: unclear with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa along lower wall facing the TV/inner wall; armchairs near central seating zone facing toward living centre. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom in a central position within the apartment. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 2 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households. Not suitable for: households needing significant storage (no wardrobes shown — very limited storage); large families needing more than one bathroom; anyone requiring an accessible step-free direct entry into living spaces.
